name: FAQ
description: Element type that shows the elements of a category and its subcategories as FAQ: subcategories become collapsible sections, pages become collapsible questions with their content as answer. With search within the FAQ, quick adding of questions and sections and an Atom/RSS feed. The macro ::faq shows questions of several sources together.
author: Enterprise Wiki

permissions.label: Manage the FAQ
permissions.description: Change the settings, sections and permissions of the FAQ; includes editing all its questions and answers.

permissions.label: Edit all questions and answers
permissions.description: Write, change, move within the FAQ and delete all questions and answers of the FAQ.

permissions.label: Contribute questions and answers
permissions.description: Write new questions and answers and change or delete the own ones.
